g.text: WWV26 replaces D20 in paired seasonal LIM forecasts
All three event windows excluded: 34 training years | ERSST and standard PMM-SST unchanged
February–June starts; nine-month free integrations. Scores: common seasonal center leads 1–5, 25 overlapping pairs/event.
Main estimator: perturb2; annual + semiannual harmonics; training-only trends. Display anomalies: 1982–2022.
D20 is GODAS depth; WWV26 is SODA3 density-layer volume. Different domains/products; no claim of pure definition causality.
